About

I'm Aadil, a designer, educator, and content creator exploring how we keep people at the center of design as technology changes around us.

I've spent 10 years doing research and design at IBM, BMO, and XE, and I teach UX in Toronto Metropolitan University's Master of Digital Media program. But the work I care most about happens outside the job: making things that help people learn, create, and find their place in design.

I share design ideas with more than 6,000 people across Instagram and LinkedIn, and I'm one of ADPList's Top 100 Mentors, with more than 10,000 minutes spent mentoring designers worldwide.

Projects

Aadil.Digital

My visual blog and creative outlet, where I explore design, technology, and the people who use it. What started as a place to share ideas has grown into a community of 2,000 followers, with community calls, workshops, and activities we do together.

Curriculum Design

As an Associate Member of the Yeates School of Graduate and Postdoctoral Studies at Toronto Metropolitan University, I build curriculum for and teach User Experience Design in the Master of Digital Media program. My courses focus on bringing AI into design practice while keeping the human in the loop, grounded in a holistic approach to design thinking.

About the Master of Digital Media program
